active_contract.playlist_source: Spotify API, one frozen first-run snapshot
active_contract.spotify_metadata: full Spotify catalog metadata for processing; ISRC is the duplicate key
active_contract.audio_acquisition: Unauthenticated YT Music API search + title/artist/album/duration candidate scoring within Spotify-duration tolerance + yt-dlp selected-URL download + FFmpeg MP3
active_contract.downstream: lyrics -> Demucs -> Telugu alignment -> whole-song 8D -> optional hook deferral -> Reel-only queue resume

validation.latest_fix: CUDA-first hardening for HTDemucs, MMS/CTC, Silero VAD and NVENC, including device-aware cache invalidation and runtime provenance.
validation.live_yt_dlp_network_validation: not run in build container; outbound package/network access unavailable
validation.archived_suites: not re-run in this packaging pass

notes: Existing user database state is preserved when updating the code; do not overwrite db/ files unless intentionally migrating.

yt-dlp downloads only the exact selected URL: the authoritative audio stage receives the selected music.youtube.com URL, while the visual reference stage receives the selected YouTube watch URL. Neither stage is allowed to title-search for a replacement recording.
cpu_runtime_policy: CUDA-primary for PyTorch models and NVIDIA NVENC; automatic CPU fallback when CUDA/NVENC is unavailable or fails.
model_cache_policy: All ML model checkpoints are downloaded to and reused from project models/; per-song temp directories contain transient processing artifacts only.
latest_fix: Unauthenticated YT Music search with strong title/artist/album/duration candidate scoring; no browser.json authentication prerequisite or search fallback.

gpu_runtime_policy.cpu_only: network, metadata, SQLite, file I/O, hashing, NumPy/SciPy-oriented audio transforms
